messages:
Alex: Planning to deploy console/ui at 15:10 UTC — small asset bump and a couple of style fixes. Targeting 15:20 canary -> 15:35 full rollout. Who can own the CDN invalidation and edge priming?
Maria: I can kick off the deploy at 15:10. Will start with a 5% canary on prod and watch errors/latency. :thumbsup:
Sahil: I can handle CDN edge steps. Plan: do a staged invalidation for the changed hashes, then run an edge priming job to warm the most-requested assets. Will coordinate TTLs.
Alex: Thanks. Priming job — do we have the list for top assets? Last run was 2 days ago.
Sahil: I'll generate list from analytics. Command I'll use to prime:
```
python infra/tools/edge_prime.py --manifest s3://redwood-console/assets/manifest-2026-03-17.json --concurrency 20
```
Maria: Smoke checks before promoting to full rollout:
- curl -f https://console.redwood.ai/health || fail
- spot-check search, chat flows
- run canary synthetic from eu-west-1 and us-west-2
Cheng: I'll watch oncall dashboards and tail frontend errors. If anything >1% error rate or latency >600ms for 2 consecutive minutes, approve rollback.
Alex: Rollback plan: revert to previous tag `console-ui@2026-03-16-rc3`, re-run invalidation for new assets (so clients pick old), and disable new feature flag `ui_new_search`.
Sahil: For invalidation, prefer staged batches of 50 keys to avoid lambda throttles. Invalidation command:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1ABCDEF --paths "/assets/*-2026-03-17-*.js" --caller-reference "deploy-1938574201"
```
Maria: I'll ping when canary metrics look good. If no issues by 15:35, I'll promote to 100% and mark rollout done. Everyone OK with that?
Cheng: OK from oncall. I'll post a short post-deploy status at +10min.
devops-bot: Deploy pipeline started: console-ui/manifest@2026-03-17-15:10 (build 7432) — link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7432
Alex: Perfect — thanks team. :rocket:
